hero.title: The Nanda Dynasty: Imperial Architects
hero.description: Explore the rise of the Nandas, the first 'non-Kshatriya' dynasty of Magadha that unified North India.

timeline.title: The Chronological Framework
timeline.description: The transition from the Haryanka-Shishunaga power base to the pan-Indian Nanda Empire.

cards.details: Mahapadma Nanda overthrows the Shishunaga dynasty, marking the establishment of the Nanda Empire.
Alexander the Great's invasion; the might of the Nanda army (Gangaridae and Prasii) deters the Macedonian advance.
Chandragupta Maurya, guided by Chanakya, defeats Dhana Nanda, ending the dynasty.

items.title: M.U.S.H
items.decryption: Mahapadma (Founder), Unified North India, Standardized weights/measures, Huge army (standing force).

traps.title: UPSC Common Exam Traps
items: Mistaking Nandas as the first empire; they were the first major 'non-Kshatriya' imperial dynasty, not the first kingdom.
Confusing Nanda's army size with Greek records; always prioritize Curtius and Diodorus accounts for the 'Gangaridae' reference.
Assuming Nandas had no administration; they developed the foundational tax and bureaucratic systems later perfected by the Mauryas.

sections.title: 1. Core Study Notes
sections.content:
Geography

  • Centered in Pataliputra
  • Expanded across the Indo-Gangetic plain
  • Control over fertile mineral-rich regions

Personalities

  • Mahapadma Nanda (Sarvakshatrantaka)
  • Dhana Nanda (The last ruler)
  • Chanakya (The primary adversary)

Empire Structure & Expansion

  • Mahapadma Nanda: Known as 'Ekarat' and 'Sarvakshatrantaka' (destroyer of all Kshatriyas) in Puranas.
  • Military Might: Pliny and Curtius mention 200,000 infantry and 80,000 cavalry.
  • Economic Policy: Introduction of standardized currency (punch-marked coins) and systematic taxation.
